import pandas as pd

# Define the employment record with effective-dating metadata
employment_record = pd.DataFrame([{
    "employee_id":      "EMP-1001",
    "employee_name":    "Jordan Lee",
    "position":         "Data Analyst",
    "department":       "Analytics",
    "manager":          "Alex Rivera",
    "start_date":       pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01"),
    "employment_type":  "Full-time",
    "jurisdiction":     "California",
    "effective_date":   pd.Timestamp("2025-04-01"),
    "end_date":         pd.NaT,          # open-ended current record
    "status":           "Active",
    "record_created":   pd.Timestamp("2026-10-12")
}])

# Enforce proper dtypes for date columns
for col in ["start_date", "effective_date", "end_date", "record_created"]:
    employment_record[col] = pd.to_datetime(employment_record[col])

# Display the record
print("=== New Effective-Dated Employment Record ===")
print(employment_record.to_string(index=False))
print("\nData types:")
print(employment_record.dtypes)
